title.zh: 关联问题导出跨分节共同细化
title.en: Incidence questions yield a common relational refinement

statement.en: For two joinings connected from roots alike through their role frames, the alike fragment pairs form a common refinement whose projections keep joins, lift each join at one participant and cover both; with excluded middle and both locally finite, roots passing the same branching tests suffice.
statement.zh: 两个接合从经角色框架相似的根连通时，相似的片段对构成共同细化，其投影保留接合、在一个参与位置提升每个接合并覆盖两侧；有排中律且两侧局部有限时，根通过相同的分支检验即足够。

laws.en: A joining read through roles is the frame whose places are fragments and occurrences of joining: a fragment enters an occurrence by a role it holds there, and an occurrence is left by a role to the fragment holding it. A joining is connected from a fragment where every fragment is reached from it through roles.
laws.zh: 经角色读出的接合是这样的框架：其位置为片段与接合的发生；片段以它在某发生中所持的角色进入该发生，发生以某角色离开到持该角色的片段。接合从某片段连通，是指每个片段都经角色从它可达。

laws.en: An open map of joinings keeps the joining, and lifts every occurrence holding a fragment's image in a role to an occurrence holding that fragment in that role, mapped onto it role by role; it lifts pairs where every joining of two images comes from a joining of the two fragments.
laws.zh: 接合的开映射保持接合，并把每个在某角色上持某片段之像的发生，提升为在该角色上持该片段、逐角色映到它的发生；它提升对，是指两像的每个接合都来自两片段的接合。

laws.en: For any two joinings, the pairs of fragments alike through their role frames, joined pair by pair, form a joining whose two projections are open maps of joinings, with no premise.
laws.zh: 对任意两个接合，经其角色框架相似的片段对逐对接合，构成一个接合，其两个投影都是接合的开映射，不加前提。

laws.en: For two joinings connected from roots alike through their role frames, every fragment of either is alike to some fragment of the other, so the joining of alike pairs is a common refinement: both projections are open and every fragment of each joining is a projection of an alike pair; no finiteness and no decision is used.
laws.zh: 对两个从经角色框架相似的根连通的接合，任一方的每个片段都与另一方某片段相似，故相似对的接合是共同细化：两个投影都是开的，每个接合的每个片段都是某相似对的投影；不用有限性，也不用判定。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, configurations of two frames passing the same branching tests match each step where the second frame lists the outcomes of each move, and passing the same tests is a bisimulation where both frames list them.
laws.zh: 以排中律为具名假设：两框架中通过相同分支检验的构形，在第二个框架列出每个动作的结果时逐步相配；两个框架都列出时，通过相同检验是一个双模拟。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, where each fragment of two joinings holds each role in listed occurrences, places are alike through the role frames exactly where they pass the same branching tests.
laws.zh: 以排中律为具名假设：凡两个接合的每个片段在列出的发生中持每个角色，位置经角色框架相似，恰当它们通过相同的分支检验。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a named hypothesis and each fragment of the second joining holding each role in listed occurrences: where fragments x and y pass the same tests of roles, an occurrence of the first holding x in a role is matched by one of the second holding y in that role, their fragments in every role passing the same tests; with both so listed, roots passing the same tests cover what they connect.
laws.zh: 以排中律为具名假设，且第二个接合的每个片段在列出的发生中持每个角色：凡片段 x 与 y 通过相同的角色检验，第一个接合中在某角色上持 x 的发生，由第二个中在该角色上持 y 的发生相配，两者每个角色上的片段都通过相同检验；两侧都如此列出时，通过相同检验的根覆盖其所连通者。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, for two joinings in which each fragment holds each role in listed occurrences, connected from roots passing the same branching tests of roles, the joining of alike pairs is a common refinement whose projections are open and cover both.
laws.zh: 以排中律为具名假设：对两个每个片段都在列出的发生中持每个角色、且从通过相同角色分支检验的根连通的接合，相似对的接合是共同细化，其投影是开的并覆盖两侧。

laws.en: Where every fragment takes every role and some fragment cannot join itself, the map onto the one-fragment joining is open, every fragment passing the tests of roles of the one fragment, and does not lift pairs; for the process that moves once, the map of its traced fragments onto that joining is open and does not lift pairs.
laws.zh: 凡每个片段取每个角色、而某片段不能与自身接合，到单片段接合的映射是开的，每个片段都通过单一片段的角色检验，但它不提升对；对只动一次的过程，其被追踪片段到该接合的映射是开的，且不提升对。

hypotheses.zh: 两种部分三元接合 J、K，可有不同片段类型；同一六角色移动的有限分支语言。
hypotheses.en: Two partial ternary joining laws J and K, possibly on different fragment types; the same finite branch language over six role movements.

hypotheses.zh: 两个接合都从其根连通（两边 ConnectedFrom），两根经角色框架相似；或在检验形式中，两根通过相同分支检验，且每个片段／角色只有有限关联接合。
hypotheses.en: Both joinings are connected from their roots (ConnectedFrom on both sides), the roots alike through the role frames or, for the tests form, passing the same branching tests with finitely many incident joins per fragment and role.

The form with roots passing the same branching tests takes excluded middle as a named hypothesis (em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p) and both joinings locally finite; the form with alike roots takes neither.
hypotheses.zh: 根通过相同分支检验的形式以排中律为具名假设（em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p），并要求两个接合局部有限；根相似的形式两者都不要。

does_not_show.en: Lifting each join at one participant does not give lifting at a fixed pair: an open map of joinings can fail to lift pairs.
does_not_show.zh: 在一个参与位置提升每个接合，不给出在固定一对上的提升：接合的开映射可以不提升对。

does_not_show.en: Read through roles alone, a joining with local units collapses: every traced fragment of a process passes the tests of the one fragment.
does_not_show.zh: 只经角色读出时，有局部单位的接合会退化：过程的每个被追踪片段都通过单一片段的检验。

does_not_show.en: It shows neither one actual provenance shared by the two descriptions nor a universal ontology.
does_not_show.zh: 它既不表明两种说明有同一实际来源，也不表明普遍本体。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked: core receipts under becoming-checks (check_becoming.py, Lean 4.29.1) bind the current bytes of Becoming.Joining, Becoming.JoiningRoles, Becoming.Granularity and Becoming.BranchingCorrespondence, every declaration the laws cite with an empty axiom report. The periphery modules the laws were ported from are provenance, their receipt under explanatory-joining-refinement-checks keeping its earlier scope. No independent review.
validation_scope.zh: 机器检查：becoming-checks 下的核心回执（check_becoming.py，Lean 4.29.1）绑定 Becoming.Joining、Becoming.JoiningRoles、Becoming.Granularity 与 Becoming.BranchingCorrespondence 的当前字节，规律所引声明公理报告皆空。规律所移植自的外围模块是来源，其 explanatory-joining-refinement-checks 下的回执保持原范围。无独立审查。

next_delta.en: Establish a warranted translation of residuals, guards and formations between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing what semantic tests decide from what is actually acquired.
next_delta.zh: 在内部语法不同的说明之间建立余项、判断与形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义检验所判定者与实际取得者。

correspondence.zh: 关联节点均有真实 J 或 K 接合见证；图路径是关系检查，不自动是时间执行。
correspondence.en: Incidence nodes carry actual J or K witnesses; graph paths inspect relations and are not automatically temporal executions.

detail.zh: 由同一接合构造关联模型后复用有限分支恢复。
detail.en: Reuse finite branch recovery after constructing each joining incidence model.

output.zh: 同测为双模拟并匹配后继。
output.en: Test agreement forms a bisimulation and matches successors.

input.en: locally_finite_image_finite and match_incident connect recovery to three-position matching; related_covers_connected supplies coverage.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。根相同、每一片段自根可达的两结合有共同细化：其相同对的结合，两投影为开且覆盖两者，无有限也无判定（Joining.common_refinement）；以外围的假设（局部有限、根通过相同检验）加排中律亦然（Joining.common_refinement_of_em）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two joinings with alike roots, from which every fragment is reached, have a common refinement, the joining of their alike pairs, whose two projections are open and cover both, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.common_refinement); under the periphery's hypotheses, local finiteness and roots passing the same tests, with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.common_refinement_of_em). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.

history.en: 28 October 2026: migrated to schema 2 (DF3 batch B, study section 441): statement written from the home section; the claim split into nine laws, each read against its declarations in Joining.lean, JoiningRoles.lean, Granularity.lean and BranchingCorrespondence.lean (the role frame and connection, open maps and pair lifting, the span, the common refinement with alike roots, the tests lemmas under excluded middle, the form with roots passing the same tests, and the pair-lifting failure); the limitations, and the counterexample that repeated them and cited no declaration, to three does-not-show items, two with witnesses; a hypothesis added naming excluded middle, which the Lean takes and the record had not listed, and saying that only the tests form takes it and local finiteness, the second hypothesis reworded to the same effect; the standard boundary no-ethical-premise cited; Keeps, OpenMap, PairLifting, Matched, span, ConnectedFrom, covers, LocallyFinite and RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting added to Joining.lean's references and Fragment.traces_collapse to JoiningRoles.lean's; no premise, status or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in [incidence-common-refinement.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/df3-mapping/incidence-common-refinement.md); the exact earlier record is the first text_versions entry.
